description: What services, ports, and software are on IP <ip> — returns Censys internet-scan detail for a single host: open services (port/protocol/transport), software, location, and autonomous system. Example: censys_host({ ip: "8.8.8.8", _apiKey: "your-censys-token" })

_apiKey.description: Censys Platform Personal Access Token from platform.censys.io (API Access → Create New Token). Optionally "<token>:<organizationId>" to select a specific org.

ip.description: The IPv4/IPv6 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8"

name: censys_host
